## IndexDefinition interface

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

A named index over one or more columns.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface IndexDefinition 
```

## Remarks

Produced by [Blueprint.index()](./database.blueprint.index.md) / [Blueprint.unique()](./database.blueprint.unique.md) and by the column-level `.index()` / `.unique()` flags. Exposed for custom grammars, which is why it is `@beta` alongside [Grammar](./database.grammar.md)<!-- -->.
